title: Pomofocus Metric0 Field Completeness Score
dataSources: Pomodoro focus sessions (`pomofocus:session`), desk position logs (`upliftdesk:desk`), Elgato Key Light usage (`elgato:keylight`), calendar meetings (`calendar:event`), and Stretchly breaks (`stretchly:break`).
app: Pomofocus sessions, Uplift desk position logs, Elgato Key Light telemetry, Stretchly break reminders, and meeting calendar events sent to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pomofocus:metric0
| eval complete=if(isnotnull(value) AND isnotnull(duration_min),1,0)
| stats sum(complete) as complete_rows, count as total
| eval completeness_pct=round(100*complete_rows/total,1)
description: Measures how often pomofocus metric0 events include both value and duration.
value: Incomplete exports break joins and dashboards; completeness scoring catches schema drift early.
implementation: Require `value` and `duration_min` on pomofocus metric0 events and track completeness percentage.
visualization: Single-value gauge of field completeness percent.
grandmaExplanation: It gives you how often your pomofocus metric0 exports arrive with the key numbers filled in.
